chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 400 – Reunion with Keke (Reunion in Paradise Lost)
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, now a Death World skeleton, reunites with Keke. The little beast shows off her treasure garden, and the Sacred Tree absorbs the Seven Treasures Wonderful Tree. The Golden Lion King reappears.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 400 – Keke's Garden and the Sacred Tree's Evolution
og_description: An emotional reunion between Xiao Chen and Keke. Paradise Lost is filled with divine trees, and the Sacred Tree grows a new leaf after devouring a half-ancestor artifact.
twitter_title: Ch. 400 – Xiao Chen & Keke Reunite in the Underground Palace
twitter_description: After years apart, Xiao Chen and Keke reunite. Keke shows her treasure garden, and the Sacred Tree consumes the Seven Treasures Wonderful Tree to grow a sixth leaf.
